description.value: Romeo's is a family-owned Italian restaurant that has been serving Victoria since 1974, now operating four locations across Vancouver Island. The Broadmead Village location sits in a shopping plaza off Royal Oak Drive and offers a broad menu of handcrafted pizzas, pastas, burgers, and salads with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options. With over 50 years as a community staple and a reputation as one of the island's most-voted best pizza spots, it's a well-established stop for a sit-down meal.
